evidence.limits: No whisper.srt available; speech is taken from burned-in phrase captions (complete for 0-5 s, sampled once a second afterwards). Film clips are identified by appearance only. The man on camera has a different look from Matan in older Reels in this study (short dark hair, no glasses, navy polo, tattooed forearm); the account owner is matan.nistor and the caption is first person about his podcast, so I code him as Matan; the same look (short dark hair, beard, tattooed forearm) matches Matan in another Reel in this batch whose cover is labelled with his name. Music and sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Clip promoting a podcast episode on six character types: describes types 3 and 4 (people who tried and quit, and people who are afraid) with film-clip illustrations, caption asks viewers to comment 'אני' to get the episode.
audience: Aspiring business owners and people stuck in indecision; his podcast audience.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption is a comment-keyword offer (comment 'אני' because the episode on character types is out; six types, find out which you are; available on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts, season 7 episode 8); the video is a podcast monologue about types 3 and 4, with film clips, and says nothing about the keyword in the sampled frames.

opening.first_frame: Man in headphones and a navy polo in a podcast studio with a bookshelf, hands open on a wooden table; caption 'הסוג ה-3' in the middle.
opening.s0_1: Caption 'הסוג ה-3' then 'של האנשים:' at 0.5 s; hands settle together.
opening.s1_3: Cut at 1.2 s to a Squid Game-looking film clip in an old-screen frame on black with captions 'אני קורא להם:' then red 'אנשים חלשים!' (1.75 s).
opening.s3_5: Back to the podcast at 2.83 s: 'אלו אנשים' (2.75 s), 'שנכנסו למשחק' (3.25 s), 'הם התחילו לעשות' (4.25 s).
opening.visual_hook: A film clip cut in on the words 'אנשים חלשים' with a red caption.
opening.spoken_hook: Speech from 0 s matches the captions (machine transcript): 'הסוג השלישי של האנשים, אני קורא להם אנשים חלשים. אלו אנשים שנכנסו למשחק, הם התחילו לעשות פעולות.'
opening.text_hook: הסוג ה-3 של האנשים: / אני קורא להם: אנשים חלשים!
opening.first_sentence_standalone: no: 'הסוג ה-3 של האנשים' presumes types 1 and 2 were already described
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions carry the words and the film clip adds the mood

visual.color_contrast: Warm browns and navy; film clips are boxed on black with their own tones; white captions with red, green or yellow emphasis.
visual.props_and_gestures: Headphones, condenser mic, open and clasped hands, pointing gestures.
visual.supporting_footage: Film and TV clips in a rounded old-TV frame on black: a Squid Game scene (1.2 to 2.8 s), The Wolf of Wall Street (7 to 9 s and 57 to 58 s), a film with a couple on a street at night (14 to 15 s), Pursuit of Happyness (21 s), Good Will Hunting (22 s and 50 to 52 s), Oppenheimer (23 s), Limitless (26 to 29 s), Scarface (36 to 43 s), a Formula 1 driver (47 to 49 s), Suits (59 s), a pile of banknotes (1:00).

visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is a podcast frame with the caption 'הסוג ה-3' seen at 0 s.
visual.ui_interference: Captions sit in the vertical middle on podcast shots and in the lower third (bottom 35 percent) on film-clip shots; the film clips are boxed in the centre with black bars above and below.

editing.edit_function: Illustration and stimulation: nearly every concept (a game, a financial office, a couple, a race driver, a mobster) gets a matching film clip so each caption sentence has a picture; the red or green caption words mark the negative or positive words.
pacing_changes: t=0-10s: a clip every 2 to 3 s
t=47-52s: F1 and Good Will Hunting
t=1:00-1:04: slower podcast shots at the end
editing.ending: Closing podcast shots with the captions 'קחו בן אדם חיצוני... כי מה שעשיתם (עד היום)' and red 'פשוט לא עובד!' (1:01 to 1:04); the last second is silent.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the quick film references and the list structure invite rewatching to spot which character type applies.

sound.delivery: Steady, energetic speech at about -14 to -18 dB with almost no pauses over 64 s; slight dips to -21 and -25 dB at about 33, 43 and 55 s; the final half second is silent (-90 dB). Film clips may carry their own audio but this cannot be determined.
sound.sync: Captions follow the speech phrase by phrase, and each film clip changes on the matching word.

text.colour_coding: White default; red for negative or fear words ('אנשים חלשים!', 'פחדנים', 'הפחד משתק אותם!', 'אבל הם מפחדים!', 'פשוט לא עובד!'); green for positives ('פנו לבחורה', 'לתת גז!', 'מה צריך לעשות!', 'ללמוד לנהוג'); yellow for quoted speech of the characters ('זהו, הספיק לי!', 'זה לא בשבילנו!').
text.placement: Middle of the frame on podcast shots; lower third on film shots.
text.style: Bold white sans with a dark outline, no box; coloured emphasis; quotes in yellow.
text.density_and_read_time: Phrases of two to five words, changing about once per second; easy to read.
text.language: Declarative, labelling and quoted voices of the characters ('זה לא בשבילנו!', 'אני לא רוצה'); short numbered type labels ('הסוג ה-3', 'הסוג ה-4').
text.caption_structure: Comment-keyword hook in the first line ('תגיבו אני'), then a one-line promise that there are six types and you will find which you are, then where to listen (YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts), the podcast name and the season and episode numbers with number emoji.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew renders correctly; the quote marks in the yellow quotes are mirrored in RTL; the caption's keyword is surrounded by an odd apostrophe pair (׳אני׳).

story.setup: Type 3 of six character types: 'weak people' who entered the game and began.
story.stakes: Whether the viewer is one of the types and what holds them back.
story.progression: Type 3: people who started and quit when they got feedback (a Wolf of Wall Street clip), turned to a girl and she rejected them ('זהו, הספיק לי!'), and quit instead of continuing; type 4: 'the afraid', who know what to do but fear stops them (Scarface, F1 driver, Good Will Hunting); they want to enter the game, to stop sitting out, but they are afraid; advice to take an outside person.
story.payoff: Verdict that what they have done until today 'just doesn't work'.
story.resolution: None; the full episode is the payoff.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: it describes two of six types and does not say how to find your type
friction_points: t=0s: starts at 'type 3' with no context (interpretation)
t=36-43s: a long gangster clip run (interpretation)
t=1:01-1:04: the advice line is brief (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: תגיבו 'אני' כי הפרק על סגנונות אופי עלה

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 19 comments is not representative: the majority are the single keyword 'אני' (16 of 19), one is a fire emoji, two are short fan comments (one says he started listening to the podcast).
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Replies are 'שלחתי לך' with a heart and 'כנס להודעות' with a phone emoji, consistent with sending a DM (the content of the DM is not visible).

conversion.offer: The podcast episode on six character types, delivered through a DM after commenting 'אני' (the caption says the episode is out and available on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts).
conversion.benefit: Discover which of the six types you are.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Visible in the caption: comment 'אני' (the comments show a keyword wave and replies 'שלחתי לך'); automation not verified.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: a keyword offer for the episode the clip is taken from
conversion.destination: YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts (named in the caption); a DM link is implied but not visible.

pair_match.notes: Dossier pair DNJI0K2I9le noted as 'podcast clip with comment keyword', Aug 2025, about 60 s; I did not open the pair's frames, so the match is judged from the dossier note only. This Reel has 38K views on both Instagram and Facebook.

rights_and_privacy: Heavy third-party film footage (several feature films and a Formula 1 broadcast clip) used without visible licence; the podcast host shown is on camera only as Matan. No bystanders.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: an easy-to-grasp personality typology in numbered types, a film clip every few seconds for each idea, and a no-effort single-word comment offer (19 sampled comments, 16 are the keyword) that is delivered by DM.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: it starts at type 3 with no context, and the clip only covers two of six types so viewers do not find their type without commenting; the film-clip layer makes the content a copyright risk.

standout_moments.what: Squid Game-looking clip on 'אנשים חלשים!' in an old-TV frame: sets the film-clip device used for the whole Reel.
Wolf of Wall Street office scene illustrates 'they tried to build' and 'learned it is not for them'.
Scarface sequence for type 4 'the afraid': a long cinematic illustration.
